 Here are the Galaxy S27 wallpapers
 It’s a simplistic design, one folded ribbon twisted in a loop. There are three colour sets: two blues, two reds, and a white. It’s not the most complex design in the world, but that’s often enough. Still makes for an eye-catching wallpaper.
 Note that these are the static wallpapers Samsung has prepared for the Galaxy S27 lineup. There may be some live wallpapers too, but we don’t have them yet. If the live versions turn up, we’ll add them to the gallery.

 Beyond the official Galaxy S27 wallpapers, these images also hint at Samsung’s colour choices for the upcoming flagships. The company usually makes a version of its launch wallpaper for each phone colour. This time, it may have navy, white, light blue, pink, and burgundy in the pipeline. More on that here .
 How do you download the Galaxy S27 wallpapers?
 The full-resolution files, without our watermark, are on the Galaxy S27 page of our Samsung wallpaper gallery . They’re free with a SammyGuru account: sign in, then save them one at a time or download all five at once. Each image is 2340 x 2340 pixels.
 To put on my speculative glasses for a second, we can try guessing which colours will go on which devices. I believe Samsung will try using the red/burgundy shades for the Pro and Ultra variants, leaving the cool blues for the base and plus models. The white is an oddball, but is likely to accommodate a white/silver variant of either model.
 As for the Galaxy S27 launch, Samsung appears on track to unveil them in January or February next year. Expect more leaks as we get closer to the launch event.
